# Phase One — Current Architecture Map

> The Awtsmoos is one while interfaces appear many; the engineering task is to expose their unity without erasing any.

## Observed authorities

| Authority | Canonical responsibility | Must remain |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `awtsmoos.procedural-language/1` | Portable single-definition semantic truth | Yes |
| Universal Semantic Kernel | Compiler capability registry, selection, artifact planning, native/deferred execution | Yes |
| Creation Portal | Stable six-verb one-definition generation facade | Yes, exact contract preserved |
| Procedural Portal | World-scale orchestration, validation, planning, explanation, revisions, compile federation | Yes |
| `awtsmoos.world.v1` | Authoritative multi-resource world/project document | Yes |
| `createUniversalAwtsmoosApi()` | Transactional command/runtime/history API over world documents | Yes |
| Reality | Semantic discovery/planning and realism vocabulary | Yes |
| Nature | Ergonomic specialist generation vocabulary | Yes |
| ModelingDocument | Specialist modeling dialect lowered to canonical intent | Yes |
| ProceduralObject | Renderer-neutral execution-oriented procedural layer | Yes |
| Materials | Semantic material definitions, texture registry/cache, renderer resolution | Yes |
| Adapters | Native/Three/Blender/MitzvahWorld execution bridges | Yes |

## Dependency observations

- `proceduralPortal` imports procedural-language primitives and `universalApi/world.js`.
- `universalApi` imports Reality definitions.
- Reality imports Nature, but production Reality does not import the universal barrel.
- Root `src/index.js` already re-exports `universalApi` and `proceduralPortal`.
- Therefore a new module inside `core/universalApi` may import `proceduralPortal` without forcing the Portal through the universal barrel; the existing direct `world.js` import remains acyclic.

## Existing semantic Definition Graph

Observed schema sections already include revision, traits, relationships, behaviors, provenance, payload, actions, constraints, resources, compile, editor, metadata, and extensions. `ProceduralDefinition` already supports immutable fluent derivation and semantic hashing/provenance primitives.

## Existing compiler capability truth

Compiler capabilities already describe id/version/compilerVersion, kinds, semantic support policy, required traits, provided traits, channels, execution tier, determinism, adapters, cost, LOD, stability, description, and metadata. Registry discovery is serializable and executor-free.

## Missing product seam

There is no single canonical facade whose flat surface is exactly the semantic lifecycle users naturally expect:

`define → validate → plan → explain → compile`

The missing work is composition, not ontology. The facade should delegate to existing semantic validation/kernel/Portal/world transaction authorities and expose them under expert namespaces.
